title: Inventory every SNS topic and decide each one's end
description:
**Milestone:** M2, operators finished

**Goal.** The exact list to retire, so 'exactly two' can be checked, plus machine-only topics.

**Build.**
From source so far (not a live read):
- Papyrus: `infra/monitoring/papyrus-monitoring.yaml` (email), `infra/scheduled-jobs/lib/scheduled-container-job.ts` (email per site), `amplify/cli-login/remote-login.ts` and related alarms through `PAPYRUS_ALARM_TOPIC_ARN`, `amplify/publication/invalidation-alarm.ts`, `amplify/publication/reproject-on-deploy.ts`, `infra/email/papyrus-email-submissions.yaml`; the Amplify cost check in `docs/amplify-cost-check.md`.
- Papyrus machine-only: `papyrus-newsletter-events-<site>` (sending stack), `papyrus-newsletter-alarms-<site>` (plugin, invokes the function to pause), the event topic in `infra/amplify-app-shell/lib/cloud-email.ts`.
- Chatticus: `infra/lib/alarms.ts`, `auth-stack.ts`, `budgets-stack.ts`, `control-plane-stack.ts`, `thin-turn-stack.ts`. Babulus: `packages/construct/src/index.ts`, `packages/control-plane/stacks/backend.py`.
Add a live `sns list-topics` and subscriptions per account. Table: topic, who hears it, replacement (alarm to Caducus; SES to EventBridge; machine alarm to EventBridge rule), and open cases such as AWS Budgets, whose EventBridge support was not checked.

**Acceptance.**
Table on kanbus-2b9a27; each row has an owner issue.
